g.text: Rust Parallel Indexer - Memory Mutation Lifecycle

text.tspan: Iterate over raw 'codes'. Increment frequencies inside 'offsets' array based on group_id.
Transform user frequency counts into absolute memory locations (cumulative offsets).
Construct the 'ranges' vector storing (start, end) tuples for each contiguous user block.
Scatter original row indices (0..n) into the un-sorted 'indices' array using tracking offsets.
Get raw mutable pointer to 'indices'. Convert (start, end) ranges into isolated, non-overlapping chunks.
Rayon workers concurrently sort each isolated slice by fetching data from the read-only 'timestamps' array.

g.text: Safe concurrent access guaranteed by disjoint memory ranges
